findings.assumptions: No additional assumptions are admitted into the root claim. Reported rank-four integrality, exploratory census results, minimality of the seed and amplification mechanisms receive no proof credit here. Any counterexample restriction depending on these must remain conditional until its dependencies are established.
findings.equivalence: The two premises form an exhaustive disjoint partition of the root domain, so their bridge is valid. This is a logical partition, not a substantive reduction of the complementary problem. Ehrhart realizability, numerator nonnegativity and coefficient factorization are not treated as equivalent to the required geometric equidecomposition.
findings.mathematical_substance: The specified seed polytope, cutting plane x = z and shear U(x,y,z) = (x,y+x-z,z) provide a concrete construction to prove or falsify. The proposed verification correctly includes identification from rhombus inequalities, disjointness, convexity, integral vertices, ambient lifting and face accounting. Horn factorization at the polytope level is explicitly an outstanding obligation rather than an inference from coefficient factorization.
findings.necessity: The seed and Horn-product approach are optional approaches, not necessary conditions for resolving the root. Their failure would not refute it. A genuine counterexample requires a proved obstruction to every permitted lattice-polytope target.
findings.novelty: Novelty and openness remain unestablished by the delivered evidence. The studies summarize searches and readings, but the referenced common search records and complete fulltext readings are not supplied. Abstract-only, unavailable and unresolved potentially relevant sources remain gaps. These gaps do not prevent admitting this explicitly provisional research proposal.
findings.renewal_basis: This is presented as a new admission within the original resource limits, not a renewal justified by expenditure. Although an earlier revise assessment is mentioned, its contents are not delivered and cannot be assessed.
findings.root_connection: The proposal attacks the exact root proposition, retaining its universal quantifiers, ambient integral-affine maps, finite rational-simplex decomposition and convex lattice-polytope target. Approval is for the investigation, not for the proposition or any reported foothold.
findings.scope: The seed obligation concerns exactly the specified triple at n = 5; the complementary obligation expressly retains its zero-padded instances at higher n. A seed construction does not cover the infinite complementary family. The proposal preserves the reviewed-proof policy, 24-move and 24-run ceilings, one-worker limit and fallback inventory. No finite computation is submitted for certification.
findings.significance: A verified seed construction would establish an exact non-lattice hive instance of the original geometric assertion. A verified Horn-product theorem could provide a structural reduction, but neither its validity nor coverage of primitive triples follows from the supplied studies.

unresolved_objections.description: Before certifying openness or priority, supply the bound search and complete reading records and resolve potentially relevant hits. The unavailable KTT sources and abstract-only equidecomposability, mutation and transfer-map sources cannot receive fulltext reading credit from summaries or citations.

The seed geometry, its ambient unimodular lift, low-dimensional integrality arguments and computational minimality are not established by the delivered artifacts. Prove the required facts independently; retain 'smallest-instance' as a label rather than a certified minimality claim.

Statements that no printed route exists, that all known counterexamples are two-dimensional, or that relevant invariants exist only in dimension two exceed what the supplied summaries establish. Likewise, Turner–Wu's reported rational-polygon pair does not alone demonstrate a hive-versus-lattice-target obstruction. Restrict these statements to the inspected evidence and do not use them as mathematical premises.
